image_description: A close-up view of a wooden bookcase filled with books. The image shows three visible horizontal shelves made of reddish-brown wood. The top shelf contains hardcover books, some standing vertically and others leaning. The middle shelf has a mix of paperback books, a small decorative object, and what appears to be a glass or plastic container. The bottom shelf is densely packed with colorful paperback books. The background includes a white wall above the top shelf.

The books on the right side of the middle shelf appear to merge slightly into the background or each other, lacking distinct boundaries. The 'glass' object also has ambiguous geometry.
Some book spines have overly smooth, plastic-like textures that do not match the paper/cardboard expectation, with slight color bleeding between adjacent books.
